items.exampleEn: The job does not pay well, but it brings prestige.
items.exampleZh: 這份工作薪水不高，但能帶來聲望。

items.exampleEn: Crowds waved flags when royalty passed by in a car.
items.exampleZh: 皇室成員乘車經過時，群眾揮舞著旗子。

items.exampleEn: Tourists climbed the tower of the cathedral to see the whole city.
items.exampleZh: 遊客爬上大教堂的塔樓，俯瞰整座城市。

items.exampleEn: I was a lazy bum all weekend and just watched TV.
items.exampleZh: 我整個週末都像個懶鬼，只看電視。
items.glossZh: 懶鬼（口語，貶義）；遊手好閒的人

items.exampleEn: Confucius taught his disciples about kindness and respect.
items.exampleZh: 孔子教導他的弟子仁慈與尊重。

items.exampleEn: Some visitors stay at the monastery to enjoy the silence.
items.exampleZh: 有些訪客住在修道院裡，享受那份寧靜。

items.exampleEn: This stone tool is a relic from prehistoric times.
items.exampleZh: 這件石器是史前時代留下的遺物。

items.exampleEn: The city found a humane way to deal with the cats living on its streets.
items.exampleZh: 市政府找到一個人道的方式來處理街頭的貓。

items.sentenceEn: The cathedral took more than a hundred years to build.
items.sentenceZh: 那座大教堂花了一百多年才蓋好。

items.audioEn: The farm treats its animals in a humane way, so its eggs cost a little more.
items.audioZh: 這座農場以人道的方式對待動物，所以它的蛋貴一點。
items.questionZh: 為什麼這座農場的蛋比較貴？
options: The eggs are a little bigger
The animals eat more food than on other farms
The farm is far from the city
The animals are looked after kindly

items.sentenceEn: The young monk lived in a monastery high in the mountains.
items.sentenceZh: 那位年輕的僧侶住在高山上的一座修道院裡。

items.sentenceEn: Winning the gold medal raised the small country's prestige.
items.sentenceZh: 贏得金牌提高了這個小國家的聲望。

items.stemEn: Divers found a ____ of the old ship: a small bell that the sailors once rang.
items.stemZh: 潛水員找到那艘老船的一件遺物：一口水手們以前敲的小鐘。

items.stemEn: The new law calls for more ____ treatment of animals in zoos.
items.stemZh: 新法要求動物園以更人道的方式對待動物。

items.passageEn: High in the mountains of Spain stands a small monastery that is over eight hundred years old. The man who started it was a disciple of a famous teacher, and his old walking stick is kept there as a relic. The monastery does not have the prestige of the great cathedral in the capital, but many visitors come for peace and quiet. Even members of royalty have stayed there. The monks run a small farm where goats walk freely on the hills, and they are known for being humane: they never turn away a hungry traveler. My brother, who is usually a lazy bum at home, got up at five every morning when we stayed there, just to watch the sunrise.
items.passageZh: 在西班牙的高山上，有一座八百多年歷史的小修道院。創立它的人是一位知名老師的弟子，他的舊手杖被當作遺物收藏在那裡。這座修道院沒有首都那座大教堂的名氣，但仍有許多訪客為了平靜而來，連皇室成員都曾在那裡住過。僧侶們經營一座小農場，山羊在山坡上自由走動；他們也以仁慈聞名，從不拒絕飢餓的旅人。我哥哥在家通常是個懶鬼，但我們住在那裡時，他每天早上五點就起床，只為了看日出。

questions.questionZh: 修道院收藏了什麼遺物？
說話者的哥哥住在修道院時有什麼改變？

items.promptZh: 這位作家每年從她的書賺到不少版稅。
referenceEn: This writer earns a lot of royalties from her books every year.
Every year, the writer makes good money in royalties from her books.
rubricZh: 說每年的情況，時態配合內容（例如 earns、makes 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 cathedral 造一個句子，說說你去過或想去參觀的一座大教堂。
referenceEn: I visited a huge cathedral in Barcelona when I traveled in Spain.
I hope to see the famous cathedral in Paris one day.
rubricZh: 時態配合內容（例如 visited、hope to 等）
